name: com.idexal/idexalos
title: idexal Os MCP Gateway
description: One MCP URL for your idexal Os organization: org-assigned skills, plugins, workflows, and connections (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and MCP servers), exposed through search_capabilities and execute_capability.

install.claude-code: claude mcp add --transport http idexalos https://api.idexal.com/mcp/agent
install.codex: codex mcp add idexalos --url https://api.idexal.com/mcp/agent && codex mcp login idexalos
install.gemini-cli: gemini mcp add --transport http idexalos https://api.idexal.com/mcp/agent
install.opencode: opencode mcp add idexalos --url https://api.idexal.com/mcp/agent && opencode mcp auth idexalos
